name: mainline_source_risk_channel_attribution_v1
objective: Separate frozen role terminal risk-mean, observation-noise and epistemic-variance effects, empty-eligible fallback saturation, and the saved source-boundary noise failure without changing the model.
scope: Retain all24 overlapping source cases and complete FULL/AFTER/POINT/native reference outputs; never select only the two negative terminal cases.

Reconstruct the deployed role probability from saved centered g, aleatoric g variance and epistemic g variance with its unchanged1e-12 floor and original alpha. Require agreement with saved probabilities before interpreting any substitutions; native expert-mixture probabilities remain as saved.

For FULL versus AFTER compare all eight frozen combinations of the three risk channels, observed13 only. Keep original objective ordering, threshold0.5 and fallback; label all substitutions static diagnostics, not new optimizer arms.

For every empty eligible set, record p saturation/ties and the original standardized pre-CDF risk margin. Inspect whether probability rounding triggers objective tie-breaking; do not silently change ranking, precision or numerical tolerances.

Retain the never-observed boundary policy0 noise case and compare saved prefix10/13 eta moments and Eexpeta across source contexts. Aggregated moments do not identify unsaved component-level mechanisms; do not refit or replay to invent them.

Compare direction/reachability with existing d1000 trajectory and terminal evidence only where logged. Missing final posterior inputs remain unknown; source support-boundary behavior is not automatically a deployed-model failure.
decision: No model, threshold, precision or fallback change in this diagnostic. At most one mechanism-supported correction may be proposed for a separately frozen same-budget d1000 comparison; mixed evidence retains the current model.
statistical_unit: Report each source-archive/fold/source-family case and family summaries. Source families and archives overlap;24fold-family cases are not24independent tasks. This d50 source-policy holdout does not establish d1000 task generalization.
